name: InsertImageInWordDocument
label: Insert Image in Word Document
description: Inserts an image into a Word file at a specified location.

fields.name: WordInstance
fields.label: Word Instance
fields.description: The specific Word instance to use.

fields.name: InsertImageTo
fields.label: Insert Image To
fields.description: Specifies where in the document to insert the image.

selectOptions.label: Beginning of Word file
selectOptions.description: Inserts content at the beginning of the document.

selectOptions.label: End of Word file
selectOptions.description: Inserts content at the end of the document.

selectOptions.label: Before Bookmark
selectOptions.description: Inserts content before the specified bookmark.

selectOptions.label: After Bookmark
selectOptions.description: Inserts content after the specified bookmark.

selectOptions.label: Before Specific Text
selectOptions.description: Inserts content before a specific text in the document.

selectOptions.label: After Specific Text
selectOptions.description: Inserts content after a specific text in the document.

fields.name: InsertImageFrom
fields.label: Image Source
fields.description: Specifies whether the image is inserted from a file or clipboard.

selectOptions.label: File
selectOptions.description: Inserts an image from a file path.

selectOptions.label: Clipboard
selectOptions.description: Inserts an image from the system clipboard.

fields.name: ImagePath
fields.label: Image Path
fields.description: The file path of the image to insert (if source is File).

fields.name: BookmarkName
fields.label: Bookmark Name
fields.description: The name of the bookmark to use for inserting before/after it.

fields.name: TextToSearch
fields.label: Text to Search
fields.description: The text to search for when inserting before or after it.
